name: How long does stucco crack repair typically last?

mainEntity.name: How long does stucco crack repair typically last?

acceptedAnswer.text: The longevity of stucco crack repair depends on several factors, including the quality of materials used, the skill of the applicator, the original cause of the crack, and ongoing maintenance. Professionally done repairs using high-quality elastomeric sealants and patching compounds can last for many years, often exceeding a decade. However, if the underlying structural issues are not addressed, cracks may reappear over time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Stucco crack repair can last many years with quality materials and professional application, but longevity depends on addressing underlying causes.
